## Answers

**h01 — S3 presigned-URL refresh runner**
`s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:16`), whose `CheckAndPresign` re-presigns S3-backed attachment URLs (skips any whose `LastPresignedTime` is < 4 days old; expiry is 5 days) — `runner.go:47-132`.
Schedule: once eagerly at startup, then every 12 hours (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, `runner.go:27`; ticker loop `runner.go:29-41`).
Wiring: `Server.startBackgroundRunners` — `server/server.go:162` (construct), `server/server.go:163` (`RunOnce`), `server/server.go:169` (`Run` in a goroutine); called from `Server.Start` at `server/server.go:129`.

**h02 — Webhook delivery + SSRF protection**
Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120-180` (actual send at `webhook.go:152` via `safeClient.Do`). It is reached from `webhook.PostAsync` (`webhook.go:184`) through a bounded 128-slot channel drained by 4 worker goroutines (`webhook.go:39-55`).
Protection: a custom `http.Transport.DialContext` — `safeDialContext` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:59-77`) resolves the host at dial time and rejects reserved/private IPs, which also defeats DNS rebinding. The range list and predicate live in `internal/webhook/validate.go:14-54` (`reservedCIDRs`, `isReservedIP`, escape hatch `AllowPrivateIPs` at `validate.go:41`). A second, earlier check validates the URL at configuration time: `webhook.ValidateURL` — `internal/webhook/validate.go:62-83`.

**h03 — Identity provider abstraction / implementation**
Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go` — defines the shared `IdentityProviderUserInfo` contract; note it is a struct, not a Go interface).
Implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:19-42`, `NewIdentityProvider`, `ExchangeToken`, user-info fetch). OAuth2 is the only concrete protocol shipped. Consumed at `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:12-13`.

**h04 — Direct MySQL driver construction outside the factory**
**No.** Evidence:
- `store/db/mysql.NewDB` is defined at `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:20` and the only import of `github.com/usememos/memos/store/db/mysql` in the whole repo is the factory `store/db/db.go:8`, used at `store/db/db.go:22`.
- The only other construction of the type is a bare in-package test literal `db := &DB{}` at `store/db/mysql/auth_config_test.go:12` (test-only, not production).

**h05 — Emoji reactions on user delete**
Mechanism: **explicit Go code** (no DB-level cascade).
- Explicit deletes: `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx`, invoked from `deleteUserTargetsTx` — `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:92,98` (defs at `:359,:379`), `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:92,98`, and the MySQL equivalent in `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go`. Entry point `(*DB).DeleteUser` → `store.(*Store).DeleteUser` (`store/user_delete.go` / `store/user.go:171`).
- Absence of a DB rule: the `reaction` table has no foreign key at all — `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-99`, `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:91-98`, `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql`. The only `ON DELETE CASCADE` in any LATEST.sql is on `memo_share.memo_id` (`sqlite/LATEST.sql:109`, `postgres/LATEST.sql:108`, `mysql/LATEST.sql:108`).

**h06 — RPC handlers that can trigger an outbound HTTP call to a user-configured URL**
Handlers (all in `server/router/api/v1/`):
- `CreateMemo` — `memo_service.go:70` → dispatch at `memo_service.go:157`
- `UpdateMemo` — `memo_service.go:401` → `memo_service.go:513` → `memo_update_helpers.go:67`
- `DeleteMemo` — `memo_service.go:518` → `memo_service.go:562`
- `CreateMemoComment` — `memo_service_comments.go:20` → `memo_service_comments.go:119`
- `SetMemoAttachments` — `memo_attachment_service.go:16` → `memo_attachment_service.go:48`
- `SetMemoRelations` — `memo_relation_service.go:16` → `memo_relation_service.go:48`

Convergence: **`webhook.PostAsync`** — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` (the single funnel; the sync worker then calls `webhook.Post`, `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`). Intermediate convergence for 5 of the 6 is `(*APIV1Service).dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48`.
(Separate, non-webhook outbound path: `GetLinkMetadata`/`BatchGetLinkMetadata` → `fetchHTMLMeta` → `httpgetter.GetHTMLMeta` — `memo_service_link_metadata.go:46`, `memo_service.go:28`. Those URLs are request-supplied, not user-*configured*.)

**h07 — Avatar request → data layer**
- Route registration `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124`
- `(*FileServerService).serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
- `(*FileServerService).getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `(*Store).GetUser` — `store/user.go:148` (checks `userCache` only on ID lookups; username lookups always fall through)
- `(*Store).ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136` → `s.driver.ListUsers`
- `(*DB).ListUsers` (sqlite default) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88` (mysql/postgres equivalents in `store/db/mysql/user.go`, `store/db/postgres/user.go`)
- Image bytes come from the user row's `avatar_url` data-URI, decoded by `parseDataURI` and written with `c.Blob` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:193-207`

**h08 — `RunOnce` declarers**
- `*s3presign.Runner` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — **invoked** — caller `Server.startBackgroundRunners`, `server/server.go:163` (and internally from its own ticker loop, `runner.go:36`)
- `*memopayload.Runner` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — **not invoked** anywhere (no production or test caller; `memopayload.NewRunner` at `runner.go:19` is also never called). Only the package-level helper `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` is used, from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` and `:447`.

**h09 — `Close` declarations**
Count: **8** concrete declarations (6 non-test, 2 test helpers), plus 2 interface declarations.
Concrete: `(*SSEHub)` `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99`; `(*Store)` `store/store.go:72`; `(*cache.Cache)` `store/cache/cache.go:187`; `(*DB)` sqlite `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`; `(*DB)` postgres `store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`; `(*DB)` mysql `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47`; test-only `(*MemoFilterTestContext)` `store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:200` and `(*AttachmentFilterTestContext)` `store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:282`.
Interface declarations: `store.Driver.Close` `store/driver.go:12`; `cache.Interface.Close` `store/cache/cache.go:31`.
Invoked from non-test server code:
- `(*Store).Close` ← `server/server.go:146` (`Server.Shutdown`)
- `(*SSEHub).Close` ← `server/server.go:206` (`closeLongLivedConnections`)
- `(*cache.Cache).Close` ← `store/store.go:74-76` (×3 caches)
- `store.Driver.Close` → the sqlite/postgres/mysql `(*DB).Close` ← `store/store.go:78` (sqlite on a default install)

**h10 — Highest fan-in under `internal/`**
`(*filter.Engine).CompileToStatement` — `internal/filter/engine.go:74` — **≈34–38 inbound call sites** (graph fan-in 34; 38 textual `.CompileToStatement(` sites, of which 7 are non-test: `internal/filter/helpers.go:11`, `store/db/{sqlite,mysql}/memo_relation.go`, `store/db/postgres/memo_relation.go` ×2, `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:413`, `shortcut_service.go:356`).
Caveat: the raw knowledge-graph top entries (`internal.version.Len` 179, `internal.scheduler.Error` 142, `internal.scheduler.Next`) are name-collision artifacts — `SortVersion.Len` is a `sort.Interface` method (`internal/version/version.go:44`) and the "Error"/"Next" hits resolve to `rows.Next()`/`err.Error()` calls, not to these symbols. If unexported helpers count, `(*renderer).addArg` — `internal/filter/render.go:842` — has 28 non-test call sites, all within `internal/filter/render.go`.

**h11 — Store entity types by external package reach**
1st: **`store.User`** — ~7 packages outside `store/` (`server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`); 11 packages if the three `store/db/*` driver packages are counted.
2nd: **`store.Memo`** — ~6 packages outside `store/` (`server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`); 10 with drivers.
(Next tier: `store.Attachment` ~4, then `store.MemoShare` / `store.Inbox` / `store.MemoRelation` ~3 each.)

**h12 — Concrete INSERT for a memo on a default install**
Concrete method: **`(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo`** — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16`, statement built at `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:41` (`INSERT INTO \`memo\` (...) VALUES (...) RETURNING ...`).
Determination: `store.(*Store).CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go:109`) delegates to the `store.Driver` interface field (`store/store.go:19`, interface at `store/driver.go`). The concrete driver is chosen in `db.NewDBDriver` by `profile.Driver` — `store/db/db.go:14-26`. With no flags, `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")` and the flag default `"sqlite"` (`cmd/memos/main.go:122`, `:130`) select the `sqlite` branch (`store/db/db.go:20`), and the driver is injected into the store at `cmd/memos/main.go:57-64`. So of the three candidates (sqlite/postgres/mysql `(*DB).CreateMemo`), the sqlite one runs.

**h13 — Markdown interface dispatch**
Interface: `markdown.Service` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55`.
Implementation: exactly one — the unexported `*markdown.service` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58-60` (methods at `:143`, `:193`, `:244`, `:255`, `:264`, `:349`, `:356`, `:425`). No mock/fake implementation exists anywhere.
Construction: `markdown.NewService(...)` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`; the single production call site is `NewAPIV1Service` — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51` (with `WithTagExtension` + `WithMentionExtension`). Test construction at `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`.
Holders: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`); `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, injected from the API service at `server/server.go:85`); `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`, never constructed in production) and the free function `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(_, _, markdown.Service)` (`runner.go:74`).

**h14 — Derived memo metadata**
Computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-86`, which calls `markdown.(*service).ExtractAll` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-422` (single AST walk) and assigns `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`.
Triggers: `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`; `UpdateMemo` when the `content` field is in the update mask — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`. A bulk backfill path exists in `memopayload.(*Runner).RunOnce` (`runner.go:27-71`) but is never wired up (see h08).
Extracted: deduplicated `#tags` (case preserved, tags inside links/images excluded — `markdown.go:376-378`, `:122-140`) and `MemoPayload_Property`: `Title` (text of a leading H1), `HasLink`, `HasCode` (code block/fenced/inline span), `HasTaskList`, `HasIncompleteTasks` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:383-405`. `Mentions` are also extracted by `ExtractAll` but not stored in the payload.
Separately derived for previews: `Memo.Snippet`, computed at convert time by `getMemoContentSnippet` → `GenerateSnippet(content, 64)` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-90`, used at `memo_service_converter.go:76,225,248`.

---

**r01 — Redis / user-entry TTL**
Premise is wrong: there is **no Redis anywhere** in this codebase (no `redis` import, dependency, or config — repo-wide grep returns nothing; `go.mod` has no Redis client). The cache layer is a process-local in-memory cache: `store/cache/cache.go` (`Cache` struct at `:65`, `sync.Map`-backed, TTL sweep goroutine, `Close` at `:187`). Three instances — instance settings, users, user settings — are created in `store.New` at `store/store.go:37-52` with `DefaultTTL: 10 * time.Minute`, `CleanupInterval: 5 * time.Minute`, `MaxItems: 1000`. So user entries expire after **10 minutes** in-process, per server instance; nothing is shared across replicas. Invalidation on write: `store/user_delete.go:38-46`, `store/user.go:143,167`.

**r02 — Per-user API rate-limiting middleware**
Premise is wrong: **no rate-limiting middleware exists and none is registered.** The Echo middleware chain is only `middleware.Recover()` and the CORS middleware (`server/server.go:51-52`); the API v1 chain adds authentication/authorization only (`NewAuthorizer` + gateway middleware / Connect interceptors, `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:65-90`). Repo-wide grep for `ratelimit`/`rate_limit`/`limiter` finds only a doc comment aspiration in `internal/email/doc.go:86`. The only throttles present are concurrency semaphores for image work (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:57-58`, `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:107`) and the bounded 128-slot webhook queue (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`).

**r03 — Nightly database-cleanup cron job**
Premise is wrong: **there is no nightly cleanup job and no cron scheduler running.** A general-purpose cron package exists at `internal/scheduler/` (`scheduler.go`, `parser.go`, `job.go`, `middleware.go`), but it is imported *only by its own tests* (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go:10`, `internal/scheduler/integration_test.go:13`) — no production code wires it up. The sole background job is the S3 presign runner started in `Server.startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go:153-174`), which runs once at startup and then on a fixed 12-hour ticker (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`) — interval-based, not clock-scheduled, so it has no "time of day."

**r04 — NATS vs RabbitMQ for webhook workers**
Premise is wrong: **neither.** There is no external message broker at all — no NATS, RabbitMQ, AMQP, or Kafka dependency in `go.mod` or any import. Webhook delivery uses an in-process Go channel: `asyncPostQueue = make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`), drained by 4 worker goroutines started in `init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55`), each calling `Post` (`webhook.go:120`). Enqueue is non-blocking and **drops** the payload when the buffer is full (`webhook.go:189-195`). The queue is per-process and non-durable: pending webhooks are lost on restart.

**r05 — GraphQL schema location**
Premise is wrong: **there is no GraphQL API.** No GraphQL library, schema file, or resolver exists anywhere in the repo. The actual public API surface is Protobuf/gRPC-defined and served three ways:
- Service definitions: `proto/api/v1/*.proto` (`memo_service.proto`, `user_service.proto`, `auth_service.proto`, `attachment_service.proto`, `instance_service.proto`, `idp_service.proto`, `shortcut_service.proto`, `ai_service.proto`, `common.proto`), generated into `proto/gen/api/v1/`.
- REST/JSON via grpc-gateway under `/api/v1` — `(*APIV1Service).RegisterGateway`, `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:65`, mounted at `server/server.go:88`.
- Connect-RPC handlers — `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` / `connect_handler.go`.
Plus non-RPC HTTP surfaces: file server (`/file/...`, `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:121-125`), RSS (`server/router/rss/rss.go`), SSE (`server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go`), MCP (`server/router/mcp`), and `/healthz` (`server/server.go:67`).
